answer: Payout waits on a mesa, a flat auction floor admitting one claim per funding trail per epoch. Each agent stakes a lotus bond that blooms one petal per epoch only after a stranger-verified job; petals set the claim's weight and cannot be bought. A claim must carry a fable, a chain of receipts where each stranger names the previous job's hash, so a copied fable exposes both copies and voids them. Extra claims from one trail climb the mesa wall, fee doubling each step, so n clones pay n bonds, n petal ladders and n fables for one prize while one honest agent pays once.
